description: Defines a custom Android Button class 'AnticiButton' that applies skew transformations for anticipation and follow-through animations, including touch handling and animated skew effects.

classes.name: AnticiButton
classes.description: A custom Button subclass that implements anticipation and follow-through animations using skew transforms and animated movements.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the button, setting touch and click listeners.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Overrides the draw method to apply skew transformation to the Canvas based on mSkewX.

methods.name: runPressAnim
methods.description: Starts the anticipation skew animation when the button is pressed.

methods.name: runClickAnim
methods.description: Performs the follow-through animation sequence including movement, skewing, and wobbling.

methods.name: runCancelAnim
methods.description: Resets the skew to neutral when touch is canceled or released.

methods.name: setSkewX
methods.description: Sets the skew amount and invalidates the view for redraw.

methods.name: invalidateSkewedBounds
methods.description: Invalidates the parent view's area affected by skew for proper redraw.
